preserve: V2 model bundle, frozen source files, existing V2 and r2 archives

group_tree.training: hard question groups only; per-fold PCA

pair_kernel.training: hard question groups only; per-fold PCA, scale, support vectors

gate.training: Complete 5 outer x 3 inner base cross-fitting; fit gate on inner OOF only; full-train gate uses saved 5-fold train OOF; no outer labels in gate fitting
gate.features: 18 question-level inputs + bias, softmax around frozen V2 weights

normalization: Valid-candidate per-question centered scores; reference and new family each divided by train OOF standard deviation; invalid sentinels excluded. Gates preserve V2 scale and use no extra blending.
notes: Development folds reuse previously studied labels and are not a fresh untouched holdout.
Do not infer leaderboard percentile or new test accuracy from these experiments.
No increase of grid after viewing scores.

public_excerpt.status: Public excerpt of the original dated development protocol; not a byte-identical copy.
public_excerpt.editorial_scope: Internal source-review discussion omitted; model-purpose wording describes the method only. Experimental configurations, split rules, seeds, thresholds, constraints and historical selection information are unchanged.
public_excerpt.historical_hashes: Hashes in historical run records refer to the original complete protocol retained outside this public package, not this excerpt.
